wins: Established persistence by successfully deploying a reverse shell payload through the exposed web service.
Captured credentials from initial phishing vector enabling lateral movement attempts.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to missing sudo permissions and lack of local exploit development.
SSH brute force attempts throttled by rate-limiting, preventing shell access.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong recon led to initial foothold, but inability to escalate privileges and SSH restrictions prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stopped at sudo restrictions without checking for misconfigured SUID binaries or kernel exploits.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run comprehensive SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and ssh-audit

skill_cards.if_condition: When web application responds to file upload endpoints
skill_cards.then_action: Upload web shell via burp intruder using crafted multipart payload and confirm execution.

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell obtained on Linux host
skill_cards.then_action: Run LinPEAS plus custom sudo -l checks for enumerating SUID binaries and kernel versions.

memory_ops.reason: Consistently identifies SSH configurations allowing follow-up access

next_experiments.title: Kernel exploit research after basic sudo checks
next_experiments.description: Catalog kernel version from uname -a, compare to known exploits and test via Metasploit or local proof-of-concept targeting observed vulnerability.

next_experiments.title: Automated SUID discovery
